faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kudumbashree Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Kudumbashree IFC Anchor and Senior CRP posts is 17 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the Kudumbashree Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 15 vacancies are available for the Integrated Farming Clusters (IFC) - IFC Anchor and Senior CRP posts in the Kudumbashree Recruitment 2026 drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the IFC Anchor post?
faq.answer: For the IFC Anchor post, candidates must possess a Degree/Diploma in Agriculture or Allied Sciences along with 1 year of experience in Extension and Marketing.

faq.question: Q4. What is the experience required for the Senior CRP post?
faq.answer: The Senior CRP post requires 2 years of experience as Krishi Sakhi/Pashu Sakhi/Agri CRP. Preference will be given to those who have completed CRP training.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Kudumbashree Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or in person.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the recruited candidates will be honorarium based. Specific details regarding the honorarium amount are usually provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for Kudumbashree Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for the Kudumbashree Recruitment 2026. Candidates should verify this in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can typically be found on the official website of Kudumbashree or through the direct link provided in the 'Important Links' section of job notification articles.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for posts in Thiruvananthapuram district, Kerala.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this Kudumbashree Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Online applications will not be accepted.
